summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held 21 May 2026, where ordinary and special resolutions were passed, and of a Court Meeting and General Meeting held the same day where resolutions were passed for a proposed redomiciliation to Bermuda from England and Wales under Part 26 of the UK Companies Act 2006. The filing serves as a post-meeting disclosure of shareholder votes. No deal terms, premium, or advisor are mentioned. The event is a corporate restructuring via redomiciliation, not a typical-going-private or acquisition, and thus falls under Other. Watch for completion of the scheme of arrangement and regulatory approvals.
